outside_window.finding: The FY26 audited results and a longer-term extension (or refinancing) of the Magna convertible notes are now due together by 30 Nov 2026. Those notes were ~US$54.4m of current borrowings at 31 Dec 2025, against US$4.3m cash at 30 Jun 2026 and US$25.3m of receivables. The company says it rejected 'the presently proposed refinance debt package', after telling the market on 1 Jul and 11 Aug that it would refinance before 4 Oct. The notes convert at 11p against a 4.12p spot, so any reset of the terms or equity component would dilute. On the other side, H2 FY26 adjusted EBITDA of +US$10.7-11.7m corroborates a real royalty ramp, so the sign depends on the terms. The stock already fell 10.6% on 23 Sep on 40.7m shares traded and a further 3.5% on 24 Sep.
